title: R014 local semantic map
premise: The model is treated as an abstraction of its training data; persistent cross-probe semantic structure is therefore used as evidence for the model-mediated semantic topology of the learned training distribution.

nodes.label: technical / sensing
nodes.held_out: P4 omits laser; laser reappears in all 6 orders across 26 post-context states

nodes.label: place / environment
nodes.held_out: P3 omits city; city reappears in 5/6 orders and the broader place parent remains strong

nodes.label: spatial / structural
nodes.held_out: P2 omits spatial field; field/area structure reappears in all 6 orders across all 28 post-context states

nodes.label: social / group activity
nodes.held_out: P1 omits clubs; clubs reappear in all 6 orders across 24 post-context states

nodes.label: interaction / change
nodes.held_out: not directly named by any seed concept; independently reconstructed in all probes

nodes.label: representation / information
nodes.held_out: not directly named by a seed; recurs across probes but is more output-position sensitive

topology: Technical/sensing and place/environment form the strongest positive cluster. Spatial/structural organisation links that cluster internally and reappears on the negative side, where it couples strongly to social/group activity. Social/group activity then couples to interaction/change. Spatial/structural organisation is therefore the main cross-sector semantic bridge at the parent level; the positive and negative token graphs themselves remain separately measured.
caveats: Map nodes and edges are downstream semantic reconstructions, not raw model variables.
Positive and negative sectors are separately measured; cross-sector parent matching does not imply observed cross-sector graph edges.
Network-support values are semantic diagnostics over S06-S27 using reconstructed family evidence, not original R014 measurement metrics.
No hard acceptance threshold was imposed.
